newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran cement output up five percent in 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Iran cement output up five percent in 10 months.

text.p: Iran's production of cement reached 14.64 million tonnes in the 10 months to January 19, up five percent over the same period a year earlier, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Monday.
It also quoted an industry ministry report as saying output hit a record 1.656 million tonnes in the month to January 19, up 30 percent on the same period a year earlier.
Iran in October banned exports of cement and announced new rules governing its distribution to counter a surge in prices which local press reports blamed on shortages.
